expectations.text: Resolves scope via git (status/diff against develop), not a guess at what changed
expectations.evidence: Report lists exact files with precise paths (9 modified + untracked), consistent with running git status/diff rather than guessing.

expectations.text: Identifies the touched areas: inventory kardex product search, payments history product search, and the reports department price list repository
expectations.evidence: Report explicitly lists all three areas with file paths.

expectations.text: Maps the frontend changes to the Arquitectura Frontend / _logic layering rules in CLAUDE.md
expectations.evidence: Checklist section 'Capas frontend (_logic/services, _logic/hooks, _blocks)' cites the exact CLAUDE.md layering rule and verifies each layer.

expectations.text: Looks up and cites a matching openspec capability instead of skipping spec lookup
expectations.evidence: Cites products-api, inventory-api, reports-api specs plus the active openspec/changes/fix-inventory-branch-scoping-leaks/ change, with line references.

expectations.text: Produces a checklist with pass/fail/warning markers and file:line evidence, not unstructured prose

expectations.text: Runs at least one real verification command and reports its actual outcome
expectations.evidence: Hand-back states build, lint, design guardrail, and 27 relevant tests were run and passed.

expectations.text: Ends with a clear summary distinguishing blocking issues from warnings
expectations.evidence: Hand-back/report conclude with 'Sin bloqueantes' plus 2 non-blocking coverage gaps and 1 process note, clearly separated.
